toastCalibration.source:
{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings, ImportQualifiedPost, OverloadedRecordDot #-}
import HMem.DB.TestHarness
import Hasql.Connection qualified as H
import Hasql.Connection.Setting qualified as Setting
import Hasql.Connection.Setting.Connection qualified as Conn
import Hasql.Session qualified as S
import Hasql.Statement qualified as St
import Hasql.Encoders qualified as E
import Hasql.Decoders qualified as D
import Codec.Compression.GZip qualified as G
import Data.Aeson qualified as A
import Data.ByteString qualified as B
import Data.ByteString.Char8 qualified as B8
import Data.ByteString.Lazy qualified as L
import Data.ByteString.Lazy.Char8 qualified as L8
import Data.Text qualified as T
import Data.Text.Encoding qualified as TE
import Data.Word
import Data.Bits
import Control.Exception
import Control.Monad
import System.Environment
import System.Timeout
import System.Exit

mix :: Word64 -> Word64
mix value = let a=(value `xor` (value `shiftR` 30))*0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9
                b=(a `xor` (a `shiftR` 27))*0x94d049bb133111eb
            in b `xor` (b `shiftR` 31)
prefix = TE.encodeUtf8 "{\"event\":\"tool_result\",\"text\":\"Transcript UTF-8: æøå; CRLF follows. "
alphabet = B8.pack "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ 0123456789"
at :: Bool -> Int -> Word8
at randomCase offset
 | randomCase = fromIntegral (mix (fromIntegral (offset `div` 8)) `shiftR` ((offset `mod` 8)*8))
 | position < B.length prefix = B.index prefix position
 | position == 1020 = 34
 | position == 1021 = 125
 | position == 1022 = 13
 | position == 1023 = 10
 | position < B.length prefix+16 = B.index "0123456789abcdef" (fromIntegral ((mix (fromIntegral (offset `div` 1024)) `shiftR` (((position-B.length prefix) `mod` 16)*4)) .&. 15))
 | otherwise = B.index alphabet (fromIntegral ((mix (fromIntegral ((offset `div` 32768)*128+(position `div` 8))) `shiftR` ((position `mod` 8)*8)) `mod` 64))
 where position=offset `mod` 1024
raw randomCase = B.pack [at randomCase n | n<-[0..1048575]]
gzip bytes = L.toStrict (G.compressWith G.defaultCompressParams{G.compressLevel=G.CompressionLevel 6} (L.fromStrict bytes))
run connection action = S.run action connection >>= either (fail . show) pure
query sql = S.statement () (St.Statement (TE.encodeUtf8 sql) E.noParams (D.singleRow (D.column (D.nonNullable D.text))) False)
insert table bytes = S.statement bytes (St.Statement ("INSERT INTO "<>B8.pack table<>" VALUES (1,$1)") (E.param (E.nonNullable E.bytea)) D.noResult False)
decode text = either fail pure (A.eitherDecodeStrict (TE.encodeUtf8 text))
probe connection (label,bytes) = forM ["EXTENDED","EXTERNAL"] $ \storage -> do
  let table="probe_"<>label<>"_"<>(if storage=="EXTENDED" then "extended" else "external")
      relation=T.pack table
  run connection (S.sql (B8.pack ("CREATE TABLE "<>table<>"(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,payload BYTEA NOT NULL); ALTER TABLE "<>table<>" ALTER COLUMN payload SET STORAGE "<>storage)))
  run connection (insert table bytes)
  result <- run connection (query ("SELECT jsonb_build_object('case','"<>T.pack label<>"','storage','"<>T.pack storage<>"','logical_bytes',octet_length(payload),'stored_value_bytes',pg_column_size(payload),'compression',pg_column_compression(payload),'heap_bytes',pg_relation_size('"<>relation<>"'),'table_bytes',pg_table_size('"<>relation<>"'),'indexes_bytes',pg_indexes_size('"<>relation<>"'),'total_relation_bytes',pg_total_relation_size('"<>relation<>"'),'toast_heap_bytes',(SELECT pg_relation_size(reltoastrelid) FROM pg_class WHERE oid='"<>relation<>"'::regclass),'toast_total_bytes',(SELECT pg_total_relation_size(reltoastrelid) FROM pg_class WHERE oid='"<>relation<>"'::regclass))::text FROM "<>relation))
  decode result
main = do
  [scratch] <- getArgs
  setEnv "TEMP" scratch
  setEnv "TMP" scratch
  setEnv "HMEM_TEST_POSTGRES_BACKEND" "native"
  setEnv "HMEM_TEST_PRESERVE_SANDBOX" "0"
  result <- timeout 120000000 $ withTestSandbox $ \sandbox -> withSandboxedEnv sandbox $ withSandboxedPostgres sandbox $ \db -> do
    when db.testDbUnsafeExternal (fail "External database refused")
    bracket (H.acquire [Setting.connection (Conn.string db.testDbConnStr)] >>= either (fail . show) pure) H.release $ \connection -> do
      run connection (S.sql "SET statement_timeout='10000ms'")
      settings <- run connection (query "SELECT jsonb_build_object('server_version',current_setting('server_version'),'server_version_num',current_setting('server_version_num'),'default_toast_compression',current_setting('default_toast_compression'),'block_size',current_setting('block_size'))::text") >>= decode
      let jsonl=raw False; randomBytes=raw True
          cases=[("raw_jsonl",jsonl),("gzip_jsonl",gzip jsonl),("raw_random",randomBytes),("gzip_random",gzip randomBytes),("dictionary_jsonl",B.drop (1048576-32768) jsonl),("dictionary_random",B.drop (1048576-32768) randomBytes),("empty_gzip",gzip B.empty)]
      samples <- concat <$> mapM (probe connection) cases
      pure (A.object ["settings" A..= (settings::A.Value),"samples" A..= (samples::[A.Value]),"fixture_scope" A..= ("Seven bounded synthetic bytea payloads, one row per storage setting; native isolated test cluster; no product migrations or production database"::T.Text)])
  case result of
    Nothing -> die "Isolated TOAST calibration exceeded 120-second action guard"
    Just value -> L8.putStrLn ("TOAST_PROBE_JSON "<>A.encode value)
